keyVerseDR: "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's; and to God, the things that are God's." (Mt 22:21)

level1.title: Give to God
level1.story: Some men tried to trick Jesus about paying taxes. Jesus looked at a coin with Caesar's face. He said, "Give to God what belongs to God."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Whose picture was on the coin?
level1.prayer: God, I give You my heart. Amen.

activity.title: I belong to God
activity.intro: The coin had Caesar's image. You are made in God's image! Sign your baptismal name.

level2.title: Caesar's Coin
level2.story: The Pharisees wanted to trap Jesus, so they asked, "Is it lawful to pay tax to Caesar or not?" Jesus knew their wicked plan and said, "Show Me the coin of the tax." They brought Him a coin, and He asked, "Whose image is this?" They answered, "Caesar's." Jesus said, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's; and to God, the things that are God's."
level2.keyLine: Render to God, the things that are God's.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did Jesus avoid the trap?
level2.prayer: God, I belong to You. Amen.

activity.title: Hidden picture
activity.intro: Color the even-numbered cells to find the picture.

art.mainBrief: Jesus holding a coin with Caesar's face; child with God's heart
